arabic text: MAUT KI AAGOSH MEIN JAB THAK KEY SOO JATTIII HAIN MAA\nTAB KAHII JAAKAR SUKOON THORA SA PAA JAATI HAIN MAAAA
english translation text: A mother sleeps exhausted within death's embrace;\nonly then does she find a little peace.

arabic text: FIKAR MEIN BACHOO KI KUCH ISTARAH GHUL JAATI HAIN MAA\nNO JAWAN HOTEY HOWEY BHORII NAZAR AATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: A mother dissolves so deeply in worry for her children\nthat she appears old while still young.

arabic text: EIK HI HASRAAT KO APNEY AZM-O-ISTAQLAL SEY\nAANSOO SEY GUSL DEKAR KUDH HI DAFNAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: With determination and resolve, she bathes one longing in tears\nand buries it with her own hands.

arabic text: AURHTII HAIN GURBATOO KAA KHUD YEH BOSEEDA KAFAN\nCHAHATOO KA PERAHAN BACHEY KO PEHNAATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: She herself wears the worn shroud of poverty,\nyet dresses her child in the garment of love.

arabic text: BHOOKA REHNAY HI NAHI DETI YATEEMOO KO KABHI\nJAANEY KIS KIS SEY KAHAN SEY MAANG KAR LAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: She never allows orphans to remain hungry;\nwho knows from whom and where she begs to bring them food.

arabic text: ROOH KEY RISHTEY KI YEH GHERAIYAN TOU DEKHAYEY\nCHOT LAGTII HAIN HAMAREY AUR CHILAATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Behold the depth of this bond of souls:\nwe are hurt, yet it is the mother who cries out.

arabic text: KAB ZARORAT HOON MERAY BACHEY KO ITNAA SOCH KAR\nJAAGTI REHTII AAANKHEN AUR SOOOO JAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Thinking constantly of when her child may need her,\nher eyes remain awake while she herself falls asleep.

arabic text: HAADYOON KA RAS PILA KAR APNEY DIL KEY CHAIN KOO\nKITNII RAATEY MEIN TOU KHALII PAET SOJAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Giving the essence of her bones to the comfort of her heart,\nhow many nights a mother sleeps on an empty stomach.

arabic text: JAANEY KITNII BARF SI RAATOO MEIN AISAA BHI HOWA\nBACHA TOU CHATII PEY HAIN GELAY MEIN SOJATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: On countless freezing nights it happened:\nthe child slept upon her chest while she slept in wet clothes.

arabic text: JAB KHILONEY KO MACHALTAA HAIN KOI GURBAT KA PHOOL\nAAANSOO KEY SAAZ PAR BACHEY KO BEHLATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: When a poor child longs for a toy,\na mother consoles the child with music made from tears.

arabic text: FIKAR MEIN SHAMSHAN KEY AAKHIR CHATANOO KI TARAH\nJAISAY SOOKHII LAKRIAA ISTRAHA JAAL JAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Worrying over the cremation ground, she becomes like stone,\nthen burns like dry wood.

arabic text: APNII AANCHAL SEY GULABII AANSOO KO POONCH KAR\nDEIR TAK GURBAT PEY APNII ASKH BARSATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: Wiping rosy tears with her own veil,\na mother weeps for a long time over her poverty.

arabic text: SAMNEY BACHOO KEY KHUSH REHTII HAIN HAR EK HAAL MEIN\nRAAT KO CHUP CHUP KAY LEKIN ASKH BARSATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Before her children she remains happy in every condition,\nbut at night she secretly sheds tears.

arabic text: PEHLEY BACHOO KO KHILAATII HAIN SUKOON-O-CHAIN SEY\nBAAD MEIN JO KUCH BACHA WHO SHAUQ SEY KAHTI HAIN MAA
english translation text: She feeds her children first in comfort and peace,\nthen gladly eats whatever remains.

arabic text: MANGTIII BHI NAHI APNEY LIYEY ALLAH SEY\nAPNEY BACHOO KEY LIYEY DAMAN KO PHELATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: She asks nothing from Allah for herself;\nfor her children, she spreads out her hands in prayer.

arabic text: JANEY ANJANEY MEIN HOJAYEY JO BACHEY SEY KASOOR\nEIK ANJAANI SAZA KEY DUKH SEY TARHAAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: When a child unknowingly makes a mistake,\na mother trembles at the pain of an unknown punishment.

arabic text: HAR IBADAT HAR MOHABBAT MEIN NIHAH HAIN EIK GARZ\nBE GARZ BE LOSSS HAR KHIDMAT KO KAR JAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: Every act of worship and love may conceal a motive;\na mother alone serves without motive or self-interest.

arabic text: APNEY BACHOO KI BAHAREY ZINDAGI KEY WASTEY\nAANSOOO KEY PHOOOL HAR MOSAAAM MEIN BARSATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: For the springtime of her children's lives,\na mother scatters flowers of tears in every season.

arabic text: BAZOOO MEIN KICH KEY AAAJAYE GI KAISAY QAINAT\nAPNEY BACHEY KEY LIYEY BAHOON KO PEHLAATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: How could the universe enter her arms?\nYet for her child, a mother opens them wide.

arabic text: EIK EIK HAMLEY SEY BACHEY KO BACHANEY KEY LIYEY\nDHAAAL BANTII HAIN KABHI TALWAR BAN JAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: To protect her child from every attack,\na mother becomes a shield, and sometimes a sword.

arabic text: PHELEY DIL KO SAAF KARKEY KHOOB APNEY KHOON SEY\nDHARKANOO PAR KALMAE-TAUHEED LIKH JAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: First cleansing the heart thoroughly with her own blood,\na mother writes the kalima of tawheed upon its beats.

arabic text: SAFHA-E-HASTII PEY LIKHTII HAIN WHO USOOL-E-ZINDAGI\nISI LYEY EK MAQTAB-E-ISLAM KEHLATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Upon the page of existence, she writes the principles of life;\nthis is why a mother is called a school of Islam.

arabic text:
USNEY DUNIYAA KO DIYEY MASOOM REHBAR ISLYEY
AZMATOH MEIN SAANI-E-QURAN KEHLATII HAIN MAA
JAB PERASHANII MEIN GHIR JAATEY HAIN HUM PARDES MEIN
AAANSOO KO POOCHNEY KHAWABOO MEIN AAJATII HAIN MAA
english translation text:
She gave the world innocent guides;
therefore in greatness she is called the second Qur'an.
When we are surrounded by hardship in a foreign land,
a mother comes in dreams to wipe our tears.

arabic text: AISA LAGTA HAIN KEY JAISA AAGAYE FIRDOOS MEIN\nDAAL KAR BAHEY GALEY MEIN SAR KO SEHLATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: It feels as though Paradise has arrived;\nshe places her arms around us and strokes our heads.

arabic text: AGAYA GAR WAQT MUSKHILL APNEY DIL KEY CHAIN PAR\nQABR MEIN HOTEY HOWEY BHI ASHQ BARSATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: When difficulty reaches the comfort of her heart,\na mother sheds tears even from within the grave.

arabic text: BAAD MAR JAANEY KEY PHIR BETAY KI KHIDMAT KEY LIYEY\nBHES BETII KA BADAL KAR GHAR MEIN AAAJATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: After death, to serve her son once more,\na mother returns home in the form of a daughter.

arabic text: DOOR HOJATII HAIN SARI UMR KI US DAM THAKAN\nBIHAH KARKEY BETAY KAA JAB GHAR BAHOO LATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: The weariness of an entire lifetime disappears\nwhen a mother marries her son and brings a daughter-in-law home.

arabic text: DEKH LETAY HAIN NAZAR JIS WAQT BETAY AUR BAHOO\nAJNABI APNEY HI GHAR MEIN HAAYEY BAN JAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: When she sees her son and daughter-in-law look at her,\nalas, a mother becomes a stranger in her own home.

arabic text: ALLAH ALLAH BHOOL KAR EIK EIK SATAM KO RAAT MEIN\nPOOTII POOTEY SEY SHIKASTAAA DIL KO BEHLATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: Allah, Allah—forgetting every cruelty at night,\na mother consoles her broken heart with grandchildren.

arabic text: BETA KITNAA HI BURA HOON PAR PADOSAN KEY HUZOOR\nROK KAR JAZBAAT KO BETAY KEY GUN GAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: No matter how bad her son may be, before a neighbour\nshe restrains her emotions and praises him.

arabic text: SHADIYAAN KARKEY JO BACHEY JAA BASEY PARDES MEIN\nKHAT SEY YA TASWEER SEY PHIR DIL KO BEHLATIII HAIN MAA
english translation text: When her children marry and settle abroad,\nshe consoles her heart with a letter or photograph.

arabic text: APNEY SEENAY PAR RAKHEY HAIN QAINAT-E-ZINDAQIII
english translation text: She has placed the universe of life upon her chest.

arabic text: YEH ZAMEEN IS WASTEY HAIN DOST KEHLATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: For this reason the earth is called our friend—because it is a mother.

arabic text: ZINDAGANI KEY SAFAR MEIN GARDISHOO KI DHOOOB MEIN\nJAAB KOI SAAYA NAHI MILTAA TOU YAAD AAATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: During life's journey, beneath the scorching sun of hardships,\nwhen no shade can be found, one remembers Mother.

arabic text:
MUFLISI BACHEY KI ZID PAR JAB UTHA LETII HAIN HAATH
JAISAY MUJRUM HO KOI ISTRHAH SHARMATII HAIN MAA
LOT KAR WAPIS SAFAR SEY JAB BHI GHAR AATEY HAIN HUM
DAAL KAR BHAHEY GALEY MEIN SAR KO SEHLATII HAIN MAA
english translation text:
When poverty makes her raise a hand against a demanding child,
she feels ashamed like a criminal.
Whenever we return home from a journey,
she embraces us and strokes our heads.

arabic text: DAIR HOJATII HAIN GHAR MEIN AANEY MEIN AKSAR JAB HAMEY\nRAIT PAR MACHLII HO JAISAY AISAY GHABRATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: When we are often late returning home,\na mother panics like a fish writhing upon sand.

arabic text: MART-E-DAM ASAKA BACHA NAA GHAR PAR DEIR SEY\nAPNI DONOO KUTLIYAY CHOKHAT PAR RAKH JAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: If her child cannot return home before her final breath,\na mother leaves both eyes resting upon the doorway.

arabic text: APNI PEHLOO MEIN LITA KAR AUR TOTEY KI TARAH\nEIK, BARA PAANCH CHODAA HUM KO SIKHLAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: Laying us beside her and repeating like a parrot,\na mother teaches us one, twelve, five and fourteen.

arabic text: PYAAR KEHTEY HAIN KISSEY AUR MAMTA KIA CHEEZ HAIN\nKOI UN BACHOO SEY POOCHEY JIN MAR JAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: What love is, and what motherhood means—\nask those children whose mother has died.

arabic text: SAAAL BHAR MEIN, YA KABHI, HAFTEY MEIN JUMARAAT KO\nZINDAGI BHAR KA SILAA EIK FATIHA PAA TI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Once a year, or perhaps on Thursday each week,\na mother receives one Fatiha as the reward for a lifetime.

arabic text: MARTABA HOO MAA KA ZAHIR KIS LIYEY FIRDOOS SEY\nAPNEY BACHOO KEY LIYEY POSHAQ MANGWATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: To reveal a mother's rank, why from Paradise\ndoes she send clothes for her children?

arabic text: GHAR SEY JAB PARDES JAATA HAIN KOI NOOR-E-NAZAR\nHATH MEIN QURAN LEKAR DAR PEY AAJATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: When a beloved child leaves home for a foreign land,\na mother comes to the doorway holding the Qur'an.

arabic text: DEKEY BACHEY KO ZAMANAT MEIN REZA-E-PAAK KI\nPEECHAY PEECHAY SUR JUKHAYEY DOOR TAK JAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: Entrusting the child to the protection of Imam Raza,\nshe walks far behind with her head bowed.

arabic text: KAAPTIII AWAAZ SEY KEHTII HAIN BETAA ALWIDAAA\nSAMNAA JAB TAK RAHEY HATHOOO KO LEHRATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: With a trembling voice she says, 'Farewell, my child,'\nand keeps waving while the child remains in sight.

arabic text: YAAD AATAA HAIN SHAB-E-AASHOOR KA KARYAL JAWAN\nJAB KABHII ULJHIII HOWI ZULFOO KO SULJHATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: Whenever a mother untangles her son's hair,\nshe remembers the young warrior of Ashura night.

arabic text: SUB SEY PEHLAY JAAAN DENA FATIMA(A.S) KEY LAAL PAR\nRAAT BHAR AUN-O-MOHAMED KO YEH SAMJHATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: Give your lives first for Fatima's son—\na mother taught Aun and Muhammad this throughout the night.

arabic text: ALLAH ALLAH INTEHAH DEKH SABR-E- LAILA AUR HUSAIN (A.S)\nBAAP NEY KHAINCHII SINA, SEENEY KO SEHLATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: Allah, Allah—behold the limit of Layla's and Hussain's patience:\nthe father pulled the spear while the mother stroked the chest.

arabic text: YEH BATA SAKTII HAIN HUMKO BUS RUBAB(A.S)-E-KHASTA TAN\nKIS TARAH BIN DOODH KEY BACHAY KO BEHLAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Only wounded Rabab can tell us\nhow a mother comforts an infant without milk.

arabic text: SHIMR KEY KANJAR SEY YAA SOOKHEY GALEY SEY POOCHIYEY\nMAA IDHAR SEY NIKALTAA HAIN UDHAR AAATI HAIN MAAA
english translation text: Ask Shimr's dagger or the dry throat:\nthe word 'Mother' leaves from here, and Mother arrives from there.

arabic text: JAB TALAK HAIN YEH HATH HAIN HAMSHEER BE PARDA NA HOON\nEIK MADAR BAWAFA BETAY SEY FARMATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: As long as these hands remain, my sister must not be unveiled—\na loyal mother instructed her son.

arabic text: AISA LAGTA HAIN KISSI MAQTAL SEY AB BHI WAQT-E-ASR\nEK BURIDAA SAR SEY ZYADA PYASAAA HOON SADA AATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: It seems that even now, at the afternoon hour, a cry comes from a battlefield:\n'Mother, I am thirstier than a severed head.'

arabic text: NO JAWAN BETA AGAR DAM TOR DEIN AAGOSH MEIN\nZINDAQII BHAR SUR KO DIWAROO SEY TAKRAATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: When a young son dies within her embrace,\na mother strikes her head against walls throughout life.

arabic text: LASH PAR BETAY KEY PARHTII HAIN JAWANII MARSIAAA\nSHUKR KA SAJDA US AALIM MEIN BAJA LAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: Over her son's body she recites an elegy for his youth,\nyet within that grief she performs a prostration of gratitude.

arabic text: DEI KAR APNEY LAAL KO ISLAM KI AAAGOSH MEIN\nGOOD KHALII PHIR SO-E-JAANAT PALAT JAATI HAIN MAA
english translation text: Giving her beloved son into Islam's embrace,\na mother returns towards Paradise with an empty lap.

arabic text: FATIMA(A.S) KEY LAAL PAR QURBAAAN KARNEY KEY LIYEY\nBAANDH KAR SEHRA JAWAN BETAY KO SAMJHATII HAIN MAA
english translation text: To sacrifice him for Fatima's son,\na mother ties the wedding crown upon her young son and instructs him.

arabic text: APNEY GAM KO BHOOL KAR ROTEY HAIN JO SHABBIR(A.S) KO\nUNKEY ASKHOO KEY LIYEY JAANAT SEY AAJATII HAIN MAAA
english translation text: For those who forget their own grief and weep for Shabbir,\na mother comes from Paradise to receive their tears.
